title: AAMS announces 40 Under 40: Rising Leaders in Medical Transport Award recipients
summary: These awards celebrate individuals age 40 or under who are demonstrating outstanding leadership, innovation, and excellence.
body_markdown:
The Association of Air Medical Services (AAMS) has announced the recipients of the 2026 40 Under 40: Rising Leaders in Medical Transport Awards, recognizing an exceptional group of emerging professionals who are shaping the future of the medical transport industry.


The 40 Under 40 Awards celebrate individuals age 40 or under who are demonstrating outstanding leadership, innovation, and excellence across all facets of medical transport, including clinical care, communications, operations, safety, advocacy, education, and administration.


“AAMS is excited to spotlight these rising leaders within our community,” said Jana Williams, AAMS president and CEO.


“The individuals recognized through this program represent the diverse disciplines that make up our workforce and showcase leaders already making meaningful contributions to our industry and communities. We are honored to celebrate their achievements and look forward to the impact they will continue to make throughout their careers.”


## **Honoring Excellence, Inspiring the Next Generation**


Nominees were evaluated based on demonstrated leadership, professional achievement, innovation, commitment to excellence, and overall contributions to the medical transport profession through a competitive written nomination process.

## Recognition at AMTC26


The 2026 40 Under 40 recipients will be honored during the Air Medical Transport Conference (AMTC26), where they will be recognized alongside peers, industry leaders, and colleagues from across the medical transport community.


Recognition events will include:


• Tuesday, October 27, 2026 | 3:30 p.m.
AAMS Community Awards Celebration


• Tuesday, October 27, 2026 | 5:00 p.m.


40 Under 40 Awards Reception & Recognition Ceremony at the AAMS Booth in the Exhibit Hall


All nominees and recipients will be recognized during the Community Awards Celebration, with award recipients receiving individual recognition during the 40 Under 40 Reception & Recognition Ceremony immediately following.


In addition, recipients will participate in an exclusive networking experience designed to foster peer connections, facilitate mentorship opportunities, and support continued leadership development within the industry.


To learn more about the AAMS 40 Under 40: Rising Leaders in Medical Transport Awards program, including future nomination opportunities, visit https://aams.org/page/40under40.


*This press release was prepared and distributed by the Association of Air Medical Services.*
